verdict.reason: Confirmed at page3.sentences[index=13]: "before it is finished" is tagged S="it", V="is", M="finished." This is a mis-tag. "is finished" is a passive construction (be + past participle), so "finished" is either part of the verb (V, passive) or a predicate complement (C) — it is not an adverbial modifier (M). The internal-consistency evidence is accurate and decisive: index=14 tags the parallel passive "are shared" as a single V ("are shared,"), and index=2/7/20 tag predicate complements after "is" as C (e.g., "easy to miss" = C at index=2). Under either the file's own passive convention (V) or copula-complement convention (C), M is inadmissible. Genuine defect.
